title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island
issues: At the start of a stage the side columns show old tiles: the game draws the level into video RAM only as Yoshi moves, so for the first screens the sides hold whatever was there before.
The game draws only what is near the SNES picture: further out, the sides lag behind by a few frames when Yoshi moves fast.
Enemies appear near the SNES edge (the game creates them as they come near).
Fast CPU speeds up the 65816 only, not the Super FX 2 that draws the game's special effects: the effects keep their speed, the rest of the game's timing changes.
